evidence.quote: We propose a $38 million class fund, with $3 million in separately paid fees and expenses subject to court approval.
Any amount not awarded as fees would go to the class.
any fee reduction should benefit the class rather than revert to Brightline.

summary: Plaintiff’s counsel first raised fees in its opening proposal, before the class fund was settled. The transcript explicitly links unawarded or reduced fees to additional class benefit, but there is no indication that class counsel pursued its own fee interest, prioritized the firm over the class, or that defense leveraged fees to reduce class relief. The declaration is not misleading because it does not falsely claim fees were discussed only after class relief was agreed.
